topic: Vibration of rotor and gearbox vibrators, disc cause effects on helicopter monitoring devices and remedial action.
syllabus_extract: Vibration of rotor and gearbox vibrators, disc cause effects on helicopter monitoring devices and remedial action. On hand experience to use vibration measuring equipment’s.
specific_objectives: 13.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the helicopter control, main rotor movements, translation flight, power, auto rotation, vibration checks and various adjustments.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstrate use of vibration measuring equipment on simulated rotor/gearbox components; Safety: Wear PPE, ensure equipment is calibrated; Supervision: Instructor monitors probe placement and data reading.
intro_questions: What are the primary sources of vibration in a helicopter rotor system?
How does excessive vibration affect helicopter monitoring devices?
List three common causes of gearbox vibrator issues.

development.content:
Main rotor movement dynamics
Translation flight vibration characteristics
Power transmission vibration effects
Auto rotation vibration behavior
Standard vibration check procedures

Disc causes of rotor vibration
Gearbox vibrator failure modes
Impact on monitoring device accuracy
Interpretation of vibration data trends
Remedial actions for identified faults

topics: Probe placement on rotor and gearbox
development.content:
Operation of vibration measuring equipment
Calibration and zeroing procedures
Probe placement on rotor and gearbox
Reading and recording vibration levels
Troubleshooting equipment malfunctions

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between disc imbalance and monitoring device readings.
Describe the remedial action required if gearbox vibration exceeds limits.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the vibration check procedures for the main rotor, referencing the next lesson plan (LP 02) on detailed rotor balancing adjustments.
